messages:
alex_k: deploy-bot raised a compatibility alert on today's runtime rollout (2.16). Suggest we either pin model variants or roll runtime back.
deploy-bot: [alert] compat-check failed: model gptx-3q (quant-v2) -> runtime 2.16 lacks fused-attn kernel; fallback enabled, latency +120% on longseq.
mira: saw increased tail latency on canary, confirmed via traces. KV cache misses spike.
sam_t: can we do a soft-pin on the model catalog for hosted until we fix kernel selection? i.e. serve gptx-3q:quant-v1 on 2.16 instead of quant-v2.
anya: soft-pin sounds least risky. Rolling runtime back blocks other fixes. How fast can we update pinlist and propagate?
alex_k: procedure: update /deploy/pinlists/runtime-model-pins.yaml, bump deploybot pinlist version, run deploybot apply-pin --env=prod --window=30m. Mira, can you validate the pin YAML?
mira: will validate. Proposed YAML snippet:```
- model: gptx-3q
  variant: quant-v1
  until: 2026-04-02T15:30:00Z
  reason: compat fallback high latency on runtime 2.16
```
sam_t: also add a note to release notes and alert SRE on the rollback plan if pin fails.
deploy-bot: pinlist change submitted: change_id=c3459f, CI checks passed, will queue for staged propagation.
anya: timeline: submit pinlist now, staged deploy to 10% edge within 10m, canary validation 20m, full propagate in 30m if stable. If latency > 20% at canary, rollback runtime to 2.15.
alex_k: rollback playbook ready: /runbooks/runtime-rollback.md. If we decide rollback, call /ops rollback-runtime --version=2.15 --trace=1 and notify customers window.
mira: running quick validation suite on canary after pinlist apply. Posting metrics in 10m.
sam_t: tagging CX and infra slack channels once canary is green.
anya: if pinlist propagation fails or creates split-brain for dedicated pools, escalate to oncall.
alex_k: OK proceeding with soft-pin now. deploy-bot, apply and post status.
deploy-bot: apply-pin started: change_id=c3459f -> rolling to stage. Expected completion 00:12 UTC.
mira: canary metrics look good at +3m: p95 latency returned to baseline, no KV cache errors in traces.
sam_t: thanks. I'll update release notes: "Hotpin: temporarily pin gptx-3q to quant-v1 on runtime 2.16 due to fused-attn kernel degradation; full runtime fix scheduled in next patch."
anya: leaving this open for 1h then close. If anything regresses, we'll follow rollback playbook. :thumbsup:
